## Current closeout — bda35664; fresh exact-head CI required

Review of the completed green handoff runs found a real Farm/Lab purchase-boundary error and an Ascend test that never actually Ascended. Commit `bda356647c8dfbc9f5b56527896868b1287b796e` fixes the owned-Luminous predictor's floating-point grouping, current-enemy handling, upper-bound validation and safe earlier purchases with large legacy values. It adds real manual/live/offline Auto-Ascend preservation and causal regression controls. Full details and original failure fixtures: [DEBUG_2026-10-10.md](https://github.com/karahaNx/Lumenfall/blob/bda356647c8dfbc9f5b56527896868b1287b796e/docs/qa/lab-expansion-001/DEBUG_2026-10-10.md).

Repaired source SHA256 `5e8763106301b9652f3ad0b270f151c3347dfead46b1842599c06a816b487cc8`; complete tree `49fcd913b8e2ee9051f3717071d782c7f3b33091`. Local core2456/10 caught mutants; boundary2344/5 caught mutants; deterministic2182-case stress zero mismatches; actual Node8.3/V8 6.0 580 checks; mobile6420 checks/all12 profiles; Prism numerical341654 and transaction3506 checks PASS. The new boundary and stress suites are mandatory in the Lab workflow. No assertion was weakened.

**Keep draft until all required CI finishes on this repaired head and the tested combined merge-tree matches. Merge only into PR102 development, never main; no APK/build/publication.** Previous green runs below belong to the older source and do not approve this repair. Physical Android, native WebView60 and TalkBack remain final-release acceptance.

## Earlier implementation and failure history

## Scope and release hold
Research Lab only, based on validated development b46d148f. Do not merge to main or publish an APK. The user approved sequential improvements and ONE final combined publication. This PR targets PR102 development, not main.

## Implemented
Fourteen new timed Lumen/Shards projects plus six existing foundations = twenty purchasable Lab projects, grouped Foundations / Laboratory / Expedition / Refinement. The three retired studies retain paid history/work without returning as permanent shop cards.

New mechanics: two additional concurrent Study slots; future Study material discounts; discounted Mote speed tiers; unused-slot work efficiency; diverse-research work efficiency; Motes for genuine other-study completions; boss material yields; Luminous material yields; extra boss Sigils; Rarity Shard discounts; Module material discounts; Ultimate Sigil discounts; cheaper Resonate; lower required Wisp levels for future Rarity purchases.

All fourteen have explicit prices/growth, work/growth, depth unlocks, finite caps and independent effect descriptions. Old earned levels and ongoing paid work remain unchanged. New starts still begin at1x and pay complete future speed tiers; discounts are never retroactive. Seven paid slots survive save/recovery/backup. Auto-Ascend, Prism formula, existing Deed thresholds, frozen Inquiry targets, deterministic Luminous/Mote encounters, package/signing and schema2 are preserved. Conditional farming material yields participate in the earliest purchase boundary. Every relevant missing currency amount remains independently red with live refresh.

## Observed checks and current limits
Source SHA256 `498e92acfb799ce814d1035c8a58c9b47b1e586f48e08d4d9dcad4673bfef1d4`.
GitHub preparation37961389509 verified exact baseline/result digests, passed source/context,2220 new full-IIFE checks/eight causal mutants,341654 Prism numerical assertions and3506 save/payout transactions, then committed actual product a3b58075. Its first browser run reached531 checks but failed a test-driver reload race; this is retained as FAILURE, not acceptance.

Test-only commit eedf6e19 invalidates the old observation bridge before browser reload so readiness cannot inspect the departing document. The frozen offline comparison independently asserts all56 new zero/OFF/default-tier values before comparing every original state field unchanged. Original local zero-default failure is reproduced; no assertion tolerance, historical source or gameplay was altered for this adaptation. The original catalog/Inquiry tests still protect all legacy entries and add explicit fourteen-project expectations.

Temporary workspace/application workflows and encoded payloads are removed from the candidate. Current head75a89c07 uses normal read-only PR validation plus an additional Lab mobile/old-engine gate. Full browser, V8, offline and complete pre-merge results remain pending and must pass before development integration. No physical Android, native WebView60, TalkBack or final APK is claimed. Initial prices are bounded design choices, not proof of whole-campaign balance.

Task: docs/tasks/LAB_EXPANSION_001.md. Exact catalog, preservation contracts and evidence scope: docs/qa/lab-expansion-001/DESIGN.md. No full private player save or fonts are published in evidence.

## Scroll regression investigation — 10 October 2026
Screenshot failure confirmed: isolated run [38004607228](https://github.com/karahaNx/Lumenfall/actions/runs/38004607228) failed after the native Rift/Lab scroll driver exceeded the original 120-second cap. It was not a passing repair. Lab-specific validation remains separate from full game acceptance.

An isolated correction on `fix/lab-scroll-regression-104` preserves genuine touchStart/touchMove/touchEnd gestures but lets inertial scrolling settle between drags. The timeout for this long native scenario is bounded at 300 seconds, without removing or weakening any per-control visibility/hit-test assertion. Its focused three-scenario stage has passed in run [38005188010](https://github.com/karahaNx/Lumenfall/actions/runs/38005188010); the full stateful and negative suites are still running.

Those two reviewed test-only changes and an evidence note are now integrated in this PR at `14ffbeb447f7a5ddc05e96c333b539d0f8a985f4` (parent `c4019e8c`). `index.html`, 20-project Lab mechanics, saved data, and Android source are unchanged by this correction. Required PR CI: [38005987252](https://github.com/karahaNx/Lumenfall/actions/runs/38005987252), Lab-specific: [38005987321](https://github.com/karahaNx/Lumenfall/actions/runs/38005987321). Both were in progress at the checkpoint. **Keep draft and do not merge or publish until all green.**
